title: New schedule of processing fees to take effect on 12 March 2013
text:
Supervision release 12 March 2013
-
20/2013
New schedule of processing fees to take effect on 12 March 2013
The new schedule of processing fees charged by the Financial Supervisory Authority (FIN-FSA) became effective from 12 March 2013.
Changes to the FIN-FSA's schedule of processing fees are based on revisions to amendments to securities markets legislation.
The schedule is available on the
FIN-FSA website
.
